entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A very long, cylindrical wire of radius \( R \) carries a current \( I_0 \) uniformly distributed across the cross section of the wire.

## Question

Calculate the magnetic flux through a rectangle that has one side of length \( W \) running down the center of the wire and another side of length \( R \).

## Answer choices

- A: A: \frac{{\mu_0 I_0 W}}{{2\pi R}}

- B: B: \frac{{\mu_0 I W}}{{4\pi}}

- C: C: \frac{{\mu_0 I_0 R W}}{{2\pi}}

- D: D: \frac{{\mu_0 I_0 W}}{{2\pi}}

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)
